reason: Hand-written by design. commands/uninstall.md is a chassis-shaped name (validate.sh's generated-header gate), but its only renderer, the suite-uninstall chassis, was retired 2026-09-26 with the suites it served. This uninstall is a thin relay over scripts/all-plugins.sh, which removes every plugin of the marketplace from one scope with no confirmation and reports an exit code; the marketplace manifest is the list.
